criteria.requirement: Each contains a selectable box mesh of dimensions `(2,1,1)` centered at its Group origin and a child cylinder mast of radius `0.15`, height `1`, centered at local `(0,1,0)`.
criteria.action: Load the page and inspect the three pod hierarchies, geometry parameters, and initial world transforms.
criteria.expected: Alpha, beta, and gamma have the specified box and mast geometry and initial pod positions (-4,0.5,0), (0,0.5,0), and (4,0.5,0). (Tolerance: 1e-6 for dimensions and coordinates)

criteria.requirement: Dragging changes only the named local position component by `delta`, clamping x to `[-6,6]`, y to `[0,4]`, and z to `[-4,4]`.
criteria.action: Call reset(), then dragPod('beta','y',10), dragPod('beta','x',2), and dragPod('beta','q',1).
criteria.expected: Beta ends at (2,4,0), the invalid axis returns false, and no other pod transform changes. (Tolerance: 1e-6)

criteria.requirement: both must preserve the pod’s world position and world quaternion, using world-transform-preserving attachment rather than copying local coordinates.
criteria.action: Move gamma, rotate it, record its world pose, call dockPod('gamma'), then record its parent and world pose and call undockPod('gamma').
criteria.expected: Docking makes dock the parent and undocking makes scene the parent; world position and quaternion remain unchanged across both operations. (Tolerance: 1e-6 per position and quaternion component)

criteria.requirement: set `controls.target` to the selected pod’s world position `p`, set the camera position to `p+(6,4,6)`
criteria.action: Reset, drag beta to x=2, select beta, and invoke focusSelected().
criteria.expected: The controls target is (2,0.5,0) and the camera position is (8,4.5,6). (Tolerance: 1e-6)

criteria.requirement: At time `t`, set `dock.rotation.y = Math.PI/2 + (Math.PI/2)*(t/4)` and every mast’s `scale.y = 1 + 0.5*Math.sin(Math.PI*t/4)`
criteria.action: Call seek(2), inspect the dock and masts, then call seek(9).
criteria.expected: At t=2 dock yaw is 3π/4 and mast scale.y is 1.5; seek(9) clamps to t=4, producing dock yaw π and mast scale.y 1. (Tolerance: 1e-6)

criteria.requirement: Clicking any pod mesh or mast must raycast through descendants, select its ancestor pod, update a text readout to its ID
criteria.action: Project alpha’s box center into canvas coordinates and dispatch a click at that location.
criteria.expected: selectedId and the visible readout become alpha, and the gizmo is positioned at alpha’s world position. (Tolerance: 1e-6 for gizmo position; exact ID match)

criteria.requirement: `reset()` must stop playback, restore all initial pod parents, positions, rotations and scales, restore the dock transform
criteria.action: Modify selection, pod transforms, docking, camera, and time; then call reset() and inspect the complete state.
criteria.expected: All listed state returns to its initial values, alpha is selected, time is zero, and playback is stopped. (Tolerance: 1e-6 for numeric state)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
